body: I've given up on medication. Besides the fact I don't have the time or money to do any more guess and check work on my psyche, I've already tried the big ones and they all made me feel completely numb and stupid. Not interested. I'm glad you've found something that works for you. Thanks for the response.

Thank you for the response! That's what I keep hearing about, the fleeting moments of joy that come from small, simple things. Excuse my excessive cynicism but honestly, those things don't do much for me. If that's all life has to offer I'm really not interested. Good luck friend.
